create_stem_module: create a VideoModelStem module for single or multi-pathway video networks with configurable conv, bn, relu
build_basic_stem: build a ResNetBasicStem module with 3d conv, batch norm, relu, and max pooling for spatiotemporal feature extraction
build_x3d_stem: build an X3DStem module with spatial then depthwise temporal convolutions for efficient video feature extraction
create_patch_embed: create a PatchEmbed module that projects video tensors into patch embeddings for vision transformer architectures
get_stem_func: retrieve a stem function by name from the supported stem types x3d_stem and basic_stem
